notes: בְעֵינֶיךָ → *unto thee* is read as a preposition-plus-noun fusion under rule 40's closing paragraph, rather than leaving the noun unrepresented beside a preposition holding *unto*: the governed noun keeps no English of its own, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the pair is headed on the construct noun.

The multi-level chain מִשְׁנֵה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר divides by rules 19 and 29: *to the double* on the adverbial accusative (rule 33 for the supplied *to*), *of the hire* on the middle construct with a second supplied *the*, and *of a hireling* on the rectum.
